title: A Extraction for the Cover
author: Elodie Reyes
blurb: Casper Villalobos, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
